narrative:
Your loan application was denied because our assessment estimated a 39% likelihood of credit risk, which exceeds our approval threshold of 25%.

The most influential factor actually worked in your favor: your requested loan duration of just 6 months is well below the typical 18-month average among approved applicants. Shorter loan terms generally signal lower risk, and this significantly reduced your risk score.

Similarly, the second most important factor also helped your case. Having no checking account on record pushed your score in a positive direction, as this pattern is actually common among approved applicants — over 70% of them share this same status.

However, the purpose of your loan — purchasing a new car — was the key factor pushing your application toward denial. Among approved applicants, new car purchases represent a relatively small share of loans, and this purpose is associated with higher credit risk compared to more common purposes like electronics or furniture.

Beyond these top three factors, your savings being below 100 DM and your housing situation as a renter may have contributed additional concern, since the majority of approved applicants own their homes and tend to have stronger savings.

To improve your chances, consider whether your financing need could be met through a used car purchase instead, as this purpose carries a more favorable risk profile. Building up your savings before reapplying would also strengthen your application considerably. You may also wish to speak directly with a loan officer who can review your full financial picture and explore alternative options tailored to your circumstances.

prompt:

1. DATASET INFORMATION
The dataset contains information on a series of debtors that took a loan from the bank.

The target variable is whether the applicant will be a bad credit risk.

Protected attributes sex, age and foreign_worker were not used to make the machine prediction.

2. TECHNICAL EXPLANATION: SHAP VALUES
A SHAP value tells you how much a feature influenced the prediction (larger absolute value means a stronger influence) and its direction: positive pushes toward bad credit risk, negative toward good credit risk. Below are the top 3 features by absolute SHAP value.

5. YOUR NARRATIVE TASK
Write a detailed narrative explanation tailored to this non-technical reader that MUST explain:
1) The model's predicted probability of bad credit risk and what this means for the applicant.
2) Why the loan application was denied: which features were most important in driving this prediction and why (focus on the ranking of most important features).
